record_language: The task-difficulty scale is a family-aware binary Rasch posterior with per-task uncertainty. Solver-side dimensionality was probed as a preregistered exploratory analysis; exact blocked cross-validation could not certify the two-factor comparison at this panel scale (nominal ELPD delta +503.9 +/- 58.2, marked unreliable), and the named iPIE/AFQMC second-axis hypothesis was unsupported (posterior support 0.6365 vs the frozen 0.95 rule). Difficulty could be established; dimensionality could not be decided.
